title_a: Kumiho: Formal Belief Revision for Knowledge Graph Agent Memory

title_a: RAG-Survey: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models
title_b: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
claim_a: Flat retrieval-augmented generation is sufficient for knowledge-intensive question answering
claim_b: Graph-based RAG substantially outperforms flat RAG for global and multi-hop queries
annotation_notes: Pre-GraphRAG survey positions flat RAG as the standard approach. Edge et al. demonstrate that graph-structured retrieval is required for global queries, rendering the flat-RAG-sufficiency claim temporally obsolete.

title_a: Temporal Belief Propagation in Neural Knowledge Graphs

annotation_notes: The 2026 paper extends Cognee's hybrid architecture with explicit temporal belief propagation, adding time-aware edge weighting not present in the original Cognee system.

title_a: Beyond Vector Memory: Structured Episodic Recall for Production AI Agents
title_b: Mem0: Building production-ready AI agents with scalable long-term memory
claim_a: Structured episodic memory with graph indexing outperforms vector-only memory for multi-session agent tasks
claim_b: Selective vector memory achieves 66.9% accuracy with 0.71s median latency, making graph overhead unjustified
annotation_notes: The 2026 paper demonstrates that for complex multi-session tasks graph indexing yields superior recall. This indirectly contradicts Mem0's conclusion that vector memory is sufficient, without directly citing Mem0.
